chapter_name: Chapter 07: Analytical Paragraph Writing (Map, Chart, Graph Based)
learning_objective: 🎯 [Students will master interpreting visual data—such as pie charts, bar graphs, and maps—and translating those insights into a cohesive, well-structured analytical paragraph.]
warm_up_hook: 📖 Become a data detective! Numbers and graphs tell a hidden story. An analytical paragraph is your chance to decode that story and explain it to the world in clear, powerful words. Let's make data speak! 📊🔍

lesson_modules.teaching_content: Every analytical paragraph starts with an introduction that explains what the chart or graph is about. Do not copy the prompt word-for-word. Paraphrase the title and specify the time period or categories involved.
examples_or_templates: Template: The provided [bar graph/pie chart/line graph] illustrates/demonstrates [the core topic] between the years [Year 1] and [Year 2].
Example: The given pie chart illustrates the changing dietary preferences of teenagers in Delhi over a span of five years.

lesson_modules.teaching_content: Don't just list numbers! Look for the 'big picture'. Identify the highest/lowest points, striking similarities, or major contrasts. Use specific vocabulary for trends (skyrocketed, plummeted, fluctuated) and comparisons (whereas, in contrast to, significantly higher).
examples_or_templates: Trend: The sales of electric vehicles skyrocketed from 10% in 2018 to a staggering 45% in 2022.
Comparison: While basketball remained consistently popular, interest in tennis experienced a sharp decline.

lesson_modules.teaching_content: The conclusion provides a brief, overall summary of the data. No new information, numbers, or personal opinions should be added here. It is the 'takeaway' message.
examples_or_templates: Template: Overall, it is evident that...
Example: Overall, it is evident that digital news consumption has largely replaced traditional print media among younger demographics.

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ Which of the following words is best to describe a line graph that goes up and down constantly?
❓ What should you NEVER include in an analytical paragraph?
options: Your personal opinion on why the trend is happening
practice_mcq_quiz.correct_answer: Your personal opinion on why the trend is happening

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Rewrite this boring sentence to make it more analytical: 'In 2010, 20% of people liked tea and in 2020, 60% of people liked tea.'
subjective_practice.hint: Use a word that implies a massive increase, like 'tripled' or 'surged'.

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Write an opening sentence (Introduction) for a bar graph titled: 'Number of Tourist Arrivals in India (2015-2020)'.
subjective_practice.hint: Paraphrase 'Number of Tourist Arrivals' to something like 'influx of foreign visitors' or 'tourism statistics'.

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Choose the correct transition word (However / Similarly): 'The usage of smartphones increased rapidly; _____, the sale of desktop computers dropped significantly.'
subjective_practice.hint: Are the two trends going in the same direction or opposite directions?

activity_or_assignment.title: 📰 The Data Journalist
activity_or_assignment.instructions: Look at the screen time tracking on your (or your parent's) smartphone for the past week. Draw a rough pie chart dividing it into categories (Social Media, Education, Games, etc.). Write a 100-120 word analytical paragraph describing your digital habits.

chapter_summary: ⭐ An analytical paragraph consists of three distinct parts: Introduction, Body (Comparisons/Trends), and Conclusion.
⭐ Use specific vocabulary to describe changes (surged, declined, remained stable) rather than just listing statistics.
⭐ Maintain an objective tone—never include personal opinions or reasons that aren't shown in the data.
